name: hgi_seq_v27b-v27b-729887506
purpose: v27b (Claude 10-13): v26s verdict TT +15.23 / FF -61.40 / DRC 1. Hold misses are all in one clock class: reg->reg s_dsc->d_desc -61.4 (36 paths), it_d->s_dsc -43.6, trow->a0_row -41.9; SRAM write pins wd*_q->u_ring*/wd_in -26.7/-20.8 (177 paths); input ports u_done/u_fault/u_rdy -18.2. The route-time hold margin had been auto-reduced 50->25.5 ps only because 23,097 endpoints exceeded the 10,000-endpoint guard, at +3.7 util points on a 47.6% block; routing then cost ~85 ps on the worst class. This variant keeps 90 ps (endpoint guard 45000, util guard 10 pts). RTL, SDC, floorplan, safe spine unchanged; cycles 0.
